title: Kissed Garlicky Croatian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian stew featuring parma ham and a mirepoix base, made in a traditional claypot. This dish is garlicky, flaky, and festive, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in the claypot over medium heat.
Add the diced parma ham and cook until crispy, then remove from the pot.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork shoulder cubes to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, and dried thyme to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the claypot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the stew has thickened.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
